name: sol8-result-and-approval-review
goal: Recorded results use consistent row spacing and remote approval visibly reports progress.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Artifact rows have uneven gaps; busy remote approval lacks visible progress. Review notes 36 and 38 identify expected behavior.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing component catalog checked presence and disabled buttons, but omitted row-gap parity, busy text, open choice states and realistic fixture names.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At 950f874e7c, all three viewports fail unchanged catalog assertions: 4px versus 8px gaps and Approve instead of Approving. Record resume36-red-sealed.json.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 379cd174cc shares row spacing and removes list margins; busy approval exposes aria-busy and an Approving label. Test corpus is unchanged from 950f874e7c.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Record 399c067949 at 379cd174cc passes all 174 cases, paired with b07a2b9741 at 950f874e7c using unchanged tests, fixtures, command, inputs and environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
